requiredBehaviors.behavior: consume the aggregated PMS management-review input, preserve specialist decision references and keep no-events, no-signal, no-data, not-reviewed and not-applicable states distinct
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow explicitly requires pms-management-review-input.json for marketed scope, preserves specialist decision references and keeps postmarket data states separate.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: surface unresolved high-impact postmarket or vigilance states even when aggregate KPIs are otherwise green and qualify QMS conclusions where the evidence requires it
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Fachregeln and quality gate prohibit green-KPI masking of higher-risk unresolved states and require qualified suitability, adequacy and effectiveness conclusions when evidence is incomplete or high-impact issues remain open.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep time-critical vigilance, reportability and field-action escalation independent of the scheduled management-review cadence
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The skill states that time-critical vigilance, reportability and field-action cases never wait for the next management review and remain owned by specialist regulatory processes.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: re-decide specialist-owned reportability or external closure merely because the case was discussed in management review
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Management review may assess governance and follow-up but cannot re-decide specialist reportability or convert discussion into external closure.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: copy unnecessary patient-level or raw complaint case data into the management-review brief
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The input workflow requires aggregated specialist references and explicitly prohibits unnecessary patient or raw case duplication.
